In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Yuuzhan Vong '''conquered''' the [[Columex system/Legends|Columex system]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Columex was seized and razed by the invaders.<ref name="GatORW" />
